featured.name: COSMOS
featured.tagline: منصة تعليمية تجعل الفضاء تجربة تُستكشف، لا صفحة تُقرأ.
featured.challenge: المحتوى العلمي عن الفضاء غالبًا نصوص طويلة تفقد انتباه المتعلّم قبل أن يصل إلى الفكرة.
featured.solution: بنينا المحتوى حول التفاعل المباشر: كواكب ثلاثية الأبعاد يمكن استكشافها، انتقالات ناعمة بين الأقسام، ونسخة عربية أصلية بالكامل إلى جانب الإنجليزية.
featured.result: تجربة تعليمية يستكشفها الزائر بنفسه، تعمل بسلاسة على الجوال والحاسب، وتترك انطباعًا يبقى بعد إغلاق الصفحة.

items.name: 333 التعليمية

items.name: مايند فورج
items.description: منصة تعليمية تفاعلية تهدف إلى تقديم تجربة تعلّم رقمية حديثة، تجمع بين المحتوى التعليمي والتفاعل البصري ضمن واجهة سهلة الاستخدام ومتجاوبة مع مختلف الأجهزة.

items.name: منصة نشر البنية التحتية

items.name: SunGuard
items.description: لوحة تتابع أداء الطاقة الشمسية عبر مواقع متعددة، وتحوّل بيانات المستشعرات إلى صورة واضحة يمكن اتخاذ قرار بناءً عليها خلال ثوانٍ.

items.name: تداوي

about.label: عن ASL
about.title: أكثر من مجرد موقع، نصنع تجربة رقمية متكاملة.
about.body: في ASL، نحوّل الأفكار إلى تجارب رقمية تجمع بين التصميم العصري، سهولة الاستخدام، والأداء الاحترافي. نحرص على أن يكون كل مشروع واضحًا، متقنًا، ومصممًا ليحقق هدفه.
about.extra: نبدأ بفهم الفكرة واحتياجات المشروع، ثم نصمم بعناية، ونطوّر باحتراف، ونختبر كل التفاصيل قبل التسليم — لأننا نؤمن أن التفاصيل الصغيرة تصنع الفرق الكبير.

faq.label: الأسئلة الشائعة
faq.title: قبل أن نبدأ، قد تتساءل...
faq.subtitle: أسئلة تتكرر في أول محادثة مع كل عميل، وهذه إجاباتنا عنها.

items.a: يعتمد على حجم المشروع. صفحة الهبوط عادة من أسبوع إلى أسبوعين، والموقع التعريفي من أسبوعين إلى أربعة، والمشاريع الأكبر تحتاج وقتًا أطول. في كل الحالات تستلم جدولًا زمنيًا واضحًا قبل بداية العمل.
ترسل فكرتك عبر النموذج في الأسفل، نتحدث عن الهدف والجمهور والمحتوى، ثم يصلك عرض يوضح النطاق والمدة والتكلفة. بعد موافقتك نبدأ مباشرة بمرحلة التصميم.
نعم، دائمًا. نبدأ بهيكل الصفحات ثم التصميم الكامل في Figma، وبعد اعتمادك للتصميم يبدأ التطوير. هذا يوفّر وقت التعديلات لاحقًا ويجعلك ترى النتيجة قبل تنفيذها.
نعم، وتجربة الجوال تُصمم بشكل مستقل وليست مجرد تصغير لنسخة الحاسب — لأن أغلب زوارك سيصلون من الجوال.
نعم. نبني المواقع بطريقة منظمة تسمح بإضافة صفحات أو أقسام أو ميزات جديدة لاحقًا دون الحاجة لإعادة بناء كل شيء من الصفر.
بالتأكيد. كل مرحلة فيها جولات مراجعة متفق عليها من البداية، ونفضّل أن تصلنا ملاحظاتك مبكرًا لأن التعديل في مرحلة التصميم أسرع وأسهل من التعديل بعد التطوير.
السعر يعتمد على نطاق العمل: عدد الصفحات، مستوى التصميم، الميزات المطلوبة، وعدد اللغات. يصلك عرض واضح وثابت قبل البداية، بدون تكاليف مفاجئة أثناء المشروع.

items.q: هل أحتاج أن أمتلك تصميمًا جاهزًا؟
items.a: لا. أغلب المشاريع تبدأ من فكرة فقط، ونتولى التصميم والتطوير معًا. وإذا كان لديك هوية أو تصميم جاهز، نعمل عليه مباشرة ونكمل من حيث توقفت.

meta.title: ASL — Web Design & Development
meta.description: ASL designs and builds modern, fast, and intuitive websites. We turn ideas into digital experiences that make an impact.

hero.titleLead: Your idea deserves a website that
hero.description: At ASL, we design and develop modern, fast, and user-friendly websites that help you present your ideas and projects professionally, with a digital experience that makes a lasting impression.

services.label: Services
services.title: What can ASL build for you?
services.subtitle: From a single page to a full platform — every project starts with its purpose, never with a template.

items.title: Company Websites
items.description: A professional site that reflects your identity and explains what you do in a way people understand and trust.

items.title: Startup Websites
items.description: We turn your idea into a digital experience that helps you launch and introduce your project to the world.

items.title: Landing Pages
items.description: Pages we build around one clear goal: a product launch, a service, a campaign, or collecting qualified leads.

items.title: Personal Sites & Portfolios
items.description: A professional digital presence that reflects who you are and shows your work the way it deserves.

items.title: Website Redesign
items.description: We turn an outdated site into something modern, faster, clearer, and far easier to use.

items.title: Custom Web Solutions
items.description: If your project needs something different, we design and build the solution around that specific need.

value.label: Why ASL
value.title: A good website is more than just good looks.
value.subtitle: Looks earn the first few seconds. What keeps someone — and turns them into a client — sits underneath.

items.title: A clear experience
items.description: Visitors know where to go and what to do from the first second, without stopping to think.

items.title: Design with a purpose
items.description: Every element on the page earns its place, and every empty space is a deliberate decision.

items.title: Fast performance
items.description: A quick, comfortable experience across devices and connection speeds.

items.title: Room to grow
items.description: Built in a structured way, so new pages and features can be added later without a rebuild.

process.label: Process
process.title: From idea to launch.
process.subtitle: A clear way of working, in four stages — so you always know where your project stands.

steps.title: Understand your idea
steps.description: We talk through the project, the audience, and the goal — before anything is drawn.
steps.detail: A few clear questions are enough for us to understand what makes your project different, who will visit, and what you want them to do.

steps.title: Design the experience
steps.description: The idea becomes a clear structure and design you see before anything is built.
steps.detail: We start with the structure, then the full design in Figma — so you approve the final look before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Build the website
steps.description: The design becomes a real website: fast, responsive, and solid on every device.
steps.detail: Clean, well-organised development, with performance, accessibility, and mobile treated as priorities rather than afterthoughts.

steps.title: Launch it
steps.description: We test everything, prepare the site, and hand it over ready to go live.
steps.detail: Testing across devices and browsers, search-engine setup, then launch — handed over with a walkthrough of how to manage it.

work.label: Work
work.title: Work that speaks for itself.
work.subtitle: Different fields, one shared idea: a clear experience that serves the person using it.

featured.name: COSMOS
featured.tagline: A learning platform that turns space into something you explore, not something you read.
featured.challenge: Educational content about space is usually long-form text that loses the learner's attention before the idea lands.
featured.solution: We built the content around direct interaction: explorable 3D planets, smooth transitions between sections, and a fully native Arabic experience alongside English.
featured.result: A learning experience visitors move through themselves, running smoothly on both mobile and desktop, and leaving an impression that outlasts the visit.

items.name: Ofoq
items.description: A youth development platform offering programmes for children and teenagers. Designed with a native Arabic interface that respects reading direction and turns browsing and enrolment into a few clear steps for parents.

items.name: IT Infrastructure Platform
items.description: An end-to-end pipeline that takes a web application from local code to a real production environment in the cloud, automating setup so each release costs fewer hours and fewer mistakes.

items.name: SunGuard
items.description: A dashboard tracking solar energy performance across multiple sites, turning raw sensor data into a picture clear enough to act on within seconds.

items.name: TADAWI
items.description: A clinic booking app that shortens the journey from opening the app to a confirmed appointment, with a simple Arabic interface that works for every age group.

about.label: About ASL
about.title: More than a website — we create complete digital experiences.
about.body: At ASL, we turn ideas into digital experiences that combine modern design, intuitive usability, and professional performance. Every project is crafted to be clear, polished, and purposeful.
about.extra: We start by understanding the idea and its needs, then design with intention, develop with precision, and test every detail before delivery — because we believe the smallest details make the biggest difference.

facts.label: Expertise
facts.value: A Computer Science foundation, and websites that pair refined design with real performance

tech.label: Tools
tech.title: Built with the right tools.
tech.note: Technology is a means, not the point — we choose it to fit what the project actually needs.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Before we start, you might be wondering...
faq.subtitle: The questions that come up in almost every first conversation — and our answers to them.

items.q: How long does a website take?
items.a: It depends on scope. A landing page usually takes one to two weeks, a company website two to four, and larger projects longer. In every case you get a clear timeline before any work begins.
You send your idea through the form below, we talk about the goal, the audience, and the content, then you receive a proposal covering scope, timeline, and cost. Once you approve it, design begins.

Always. We start with page structure, then the full design in Figma. Development only begins after you approve the design — which saves revision time later and lets you see the result before it is built.

items.q: Will the site work on mobile?
items.a: Yes, and the mobile experience is designed on its own terms rather than shrunk down from desktop — because most of your visitors will arrive on a phone.
Yes. We build sites in a structured way, so new pages, sections, or features can be added later without rebuilding everything from scratch.
Of course. Each stage includes agreed review rounds, and we'd rather hear your notes early — changes at the design stage are far quicker than changes after development.
Pricing follows scope: number of pages, level of design, features, and how many languages. You get a clear fixed proposal before we start, with no surprise costs along the way.

items.q: Do I need to have a design ready?
items.a: No. Most projects start from nothing more than an idea, and we handle both design and development. If you already have a brand or design, we'll work with it and continue from there.
